sentences.en: It is estimated that 1.5 billion children worldwide are missing school.
sentences.zh: 据估计，全世界有15亿儿童因各种原因未能上学。

sentences.en: The value of the painting was estimated at several million dollars.
sentences.zh: 这幅画的价值被估价为数百万美元。

sentences.en: His property was estimated at one hundred million dollars.
sentences.zh: 他的财产估值达一亿美元。

senses.zh: 估计的,预计的,估算的v.估计，评价，评估( estimate的过去式和过去分词 ),（粗略）估计（…的距离、价值、数目、大小、重量、费用等），估量，预算
